environment.description: Invoice parsing microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a public subnet with an internet-facing ALB. The service is registered in the internal service mesh but the ALB security group allows inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. The ECS task role has ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. The container runs with default JVM settings and has outbound internet access via NAT gateway for pulling dependencies. No XML-specific request filtering is configured on the ALB.

config.network: public ALB, NAT gateway for egress
